{{Quote|CT-5385's condition seems to be deteriorating.''"<br />"''Tup. His name is Tup.''"<br />"''Tup? What is a Tup?''"<br />"''Tup is my friend. He's not a number.|AZI-3 and Fives|<ref name="Conspiracy" />}}
'''Tup''', identified by the number '''CT-5385''', was the name of a rookie [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was one of the many clones created for the Grand Army of the Republic by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] using [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] genetic template. He served with the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] during a [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|battle]] on [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
===Battle of Umbara===
====Opening actions====
{{Quote|You hanging in there, Tup?''"<br />"''So far, so good, Captain.|Rex and Tup, during the landing|<ref name="DOU">{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}}</ref>}}
[[File:Tup-SWE.png|thumb|left|200px|Tup in his armor decorated in the 501st colors]]
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Tup was part of the 501st Legion of the Grand Army of the Republic. During this time, [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] was seceding from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to join the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] following the assassination of their [[Senator/Legends|senator]], [[Mee Deechi/Legends|Mee Deechi]]. The Republic launched a massive invasion to prevent the technologically advanced weapons of the Umbarans from falling into enemy hands. Tup served under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Rex/Legends|Captain Rex]] as the 501st participated in the opening of the massive battle. The 501st's goal was to help capture the [[Umbaran capital city/Legends|capital of Umbara]].

As the [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] carrying the 501st landed, they were met with heavy resistance from the native [[Umbaran militia]]. After the 501st had beaten back the initial wave and established a foothold on enemy turf, the soldiers were allowed a short time to rest before pushing on to the capital. This rest was not to last, however, as an Umbaran ambush on the Republic's rear defenses forced them to retreat off the ridge they had been resting on. The ridge was cleared of enemies by [[Davijaan/Legends|Oddball]] and another pilot as they bombed the ridge with [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]].

Before the 501st could move out and try to take the capital, General Skywalker was called back to Coruscant at the request of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and replaced by Jedi General [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]]. After marching for 12 hours straight, Krell modified the original plan and sent Captain Rex and a few platoons down the main road leading to the capital of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]]. Many clones questioned this plan, including Tup. Their fears were confirmed when [[mines]] that had been buried under the main route to the Capital were detonated. This was followed by an Umbaran ambush, causing Rex to order a retreat which drew the enemy out of cover so that the 501st could see and shoot them. Reluctantly, Krell sent in some reserve clones and [[AT-RT driver]]s to aid the retreating platoons. The clones managed to hold their ground and beat off the attacking Umbarans but the plan to capture the capital via the main road had been compromised and, from General Krell's view, Rex was to blame.<ref name="DOU" />

The Umbarans soon made a counter attack against the clones. During the battle, Krell received a transmission from Jedi General [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], telling him that the Umbaran capital was too heavily fortified. General Kenobi informed Krell that an airbase was resupplying the capital and that they should capture it on the way to his position. The clones retreated from the battle zone and headed towards the location of the airbase.

[[File:JesseOnUmbara-DOU.jpg|thumb|right|Tup conferring with Dogma and Jesse as they advance down the gorge.|248x248px]]
They soon encountered a huge gorge, at the end of which was the Umbaran airbase. Krell recklessly sent half his clone forces straight down the middle of the gorge, on the argument that they did not have enough time to find a safer route, while keeping the rest of his forces in reserve for the final assault on the airbase. Almost all the clone troopers, including Tup, were angered by the poorly thought out plan which seemed suicidal and questioned Krell's sanity. During their advance down the gorge, the clones were attacked by [[Impeding Assault Tank/Legends|Umbaran Crawler Tanks]] that caused the deaths of many clone troopers. They defeated the tanks by destroying the first two with rocket launchers and the rest by spreading explosives along the opening of a hollow that the clones had been forced into.

After this victory, the clones were attacked yet again by the Umbarans, though this time the Umbaran Militia brought with them three [[Umbaran mobile heavy cannon/Legends|MHCs]]. These juggernauts decimated the clone troops because of their heavy artillery and impenetrable [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shields]]. For Tup, it seemed as if it was the end of him, but Captain Rex had an idea; although it went against Krell's orders, it would see the clone troopers achieve victory over the juggernauts.

Rex sent two men, [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] and [[Hardcase/Legends|Hardcase]], to infiltrate the airbase and steal two [[Umbaran starfighter/Legends|Umbaran starfighters]] that would possibly be able to penetrate the MHCs ray shields. Tup, and the rest of the clone forces that were deployed into the gorge, held off the MHCs until the two clones returned with the starfighters which successfully destroyed the three MHCs. The remainder of Krell's clone forces were deployed to capture the Umbaran airbase and were led by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Appo/Legends|Appo]]. They successfully captured the airbase<ref name="TG">{{TCW|The General (episode)}}</ref> but then discovered that there was also a supply ship, guarded by a strong fleet contingent, that was resupplying the capital as well.

====Mutiny against Krell====
{{Quote|Hey, ugly! Come and get me!|Tup, attempting to lure Krell into a trap|<ref name="COK">{{TCW|Carnage of Krell}}</ref>}}
After cracking the Umbaran military codes in the native militia equipment, Rex informed Krell that they could use the Umbaran starfighters to destroy the supply ship, but Krell rejected the idea. Fives recruited [[Jesse/Legends|Jesse]] and Hardcase, against Krell's orders, to pilot three Umbaran starfighters into the supply ship and blow it up from the inside.

While Tup was attempting to sleep, he was woken up by [[Dogma/Legends|Dogma]] who noticed that Fives and his two comrades were missing. Tup denied knowing about it, even though he was in the same room when Fives was searching for recruits, but Dogma convinced him to tell Krell about Fives' rogue plan after he informed him that they could be court-martialed if they knew about the plan. Tup relented and followed Dogma to Krell's command tower. However, they were stopped by Rex who inquired about the duo's purpose. Tup silently watched as Dogma attempted to trick his way into the tower, though Dogma gave up when he realized that Rex wasn't going to give. Dogma left, leaving Tup with Rex.

Meanwhile, Fives' strategy went well at first but after entering the Separatist supply ship, ray shields were raised over the ship's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]], causing Hardcase to sacrifice his life to destroy the support ship. The explosion of the frigate was seen by Rex and Tup on the ground. Jesse and Fives escaped the doomed cargo vessel but were court-martialed by Krell after they landed.<ref name="POD">{{TCW|Plan of Dissent}}</ref>

Krell then decided that Jesse and Fives should be executed so that no other clones would follow their example. Tup was one of the six clones that made up Jesse and Five's firing squad, though they all purposefully missed after hearing Fives' speech, knowing that the execution was wrong. Dogma, however, was still intent on following Krell's orders in the idea of being a good soldier, but Rex remarked that no one would follow his order to proceed with the execution. After Rex and Dogma were called to come before Krell for stopping the execution, a transmission warned them that the Umbarans had taken an armory, enabling them to disguise themselves in clone armor.

[[File:FivesJesseExecution-CarnageOfKrell.png|thumb|left|Fives' and Jesse's execution.|252x252px]]
Krell then ordered the 501st Legion to attack the enemy and warned them of the enemy's 'clone disguise' advantage. As the clone troopers reach the coordinates given to them by Krell, Dogma almost tripped on a "vine" but Tup warned him that this was a [[Vixus/Legends|Vixus]] tentacle and threw a rock at it's dormant mouth. The vixus awoke and thrashed its tentacles around for prey. Suddenly, enemy fire rang out from ahead and Tup and Dogma prepared to exchange fire but the low visibility made it hard for them to get a clear visual. Rex then ordered [[Mortar/Legends|mortar launchers]] to be fired and then asked if Kix can spot the enemy. By utilizing a [[Rangefinder/Legends|rangefinder]], Kix spotted what was believed to be hostile Umbarans wearing 212th Attack Battalion armor. As Rex moved forward up the battlefield, he spotted a deceased 'disguised Umbaran'. As he takes off the helmet, Rex realizes its not an Umbaran but a clone trooper. Shocked, Rex took off his helmet and also a 212th Attack Battalion trooper's helmet to warn both sides that they were killing each other.

Tup and the rest of the clones mourned the passing of their fellow brethren while Rex discovered, from the dying clone named [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]], that Krell had ordered them to stop enemy Umbarans at these coordinates. Waxer then dies of the wounds he had sustained during the battle. Rex leads the 501st and 212th Attack Battalion back to the airbase to arrest Krell for [[Treason/Legends|treason]] against the Republic. Along the way, the clones release Fives and Jesse from their imprisonment in the brig and giving them their weapons back.

Captain Rex ordered that Tup, the 501st Legion, and 212th Attack Battalion capture and question Krell. As they enter the tower, the clones surrounded Krell. Rex asked him to surrender and questioned him of his actions. Krell replied with taunting remarks and forced Tup and the other clones across the room by using the Force before killing several of the clones in the room and escaping out the window. He killed several more clones that were on the ground before escaping into the forest.

When Tup, Rex, Fives, Jesse and the surviving clones chased after Krell, Dogma prepared to stop them for being, what he called, ''traitors''. He pointed his blaster at Tup, who managed to persuade him to lower his weapon. Dogma relented and was immediately apprehended by two clones who then took him to the brig. The clones entered the forest and were once again attacked by Krell who began to kill clones with his bare hands.

Tup, who survived Krell's attempt to kill him, was thrown near a vixus. He came up with an idea and had Rex order the remaining clones to lure Krell towards him&mdash;and the vixus. As Krell chased the clones, Tup fired at him and taunted him. As Krell ran towards Tup, he was grabbed by the vixus' tentacles and struggled to escape. He cut off the creature's hand-like tongue and one of its vines, which caused it to release him in the process, Tup killed the vixus and stunned Krell with a [[Stun/Legends|stun]] blast. Krell was then taken back to the brig.

As the traitorous General was captured, Tup, Rex, Fives and Jesse questioned Krell for his hateful nature against the clones. He responded with the fact that he had foreseen a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|new order]], a successor to the Republic, and he wanted to become [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] apprentice by sabotaging the clones' plan, which would secure [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] for the enemy. Krell boasted that he would rule as part of it.

Outside, the group discussed Krell's fate as he said that when the Umbaran Militia arrived, they would free him and he would reveal all of the Republic's secrets to them. Tup decided that he was too dangerous to be left alive and that they should 'dispose' of him. The others concurred and went back to the brig. Fives freed Dogma as Captain Rex prepared to kill Krell. Krell taunted Rex, believing that he couldn't kill him, until he was shot through the heart by Dogma, who had taken Fives' pistol.

The 501st Legion received news that Kenobi's forces had taken the capital and stopped the remaining Umbarans, securing Umbara for the Republic.<ref name="COK" />

===The biochip conspiracy===
====Battle of Ringo Vinda====
{{Quote|Good soldiers follow orders.|Tup, moments before executing General Tiplar|audio=GoodSoldiersFollowOrders-TU.flac|<ref name="TCW601">{{TCW|The Unknown}}</ref>}}
[[File:ExaminingTup-TU.png|thumb|right|250px|Tup undergoes medical examination at Ringo Vinda.]]
During the [[Battle of Ringo Vinda/Legends|Battle of Ringo Vinda]], in which Republic forces attacked a space station encircling the planet, Tup fought alongside the 501st Legion. Shortly after saving Fives from a damaged B1 battle droid, Tup began to feel uneasy. As the battle progressed, his feelings of unease worsened and eventually culminated in Tup executing Jedi General [[Tiplar/Legends|Tiplar]]. The execution of Tiplar caused the Republic attack to lose its momentum, forcing Skywalker to order a retreat. As the retreat progressed, Fives took Tup into custody and was ordered to return him to base for questioning. Once back at a Republic command post, Tup initially seemed unaware of what had happened. However, as he was being questioned by Rex, Tup launched himself at General [[Tiplee/Legends|Tiplee]], the sister of Tiplar, though this attack failed, as Tiplee used the Force to throw him against a wall. Tup was further examined by Kix and it was determined he had suffered some sort of breakdown, though clones had been designed to withstand any kind of stress. It was speculated that it may have been some sort of virus, and Kix suggested taking Tup to Kamino, where additional scans could be completed.<ref name="TCW601" />

====Kamino Examination====
{{Quote|The mission&hellip; Free. The mission.''"<br />"''Brother, what mission?''"<br />"''You&hellip; you know the one. The&mdash;the mission, the one in our dreams&hellip; that never ends. The one in our dreams&hellip; Oh, brother. This is the end. Forget the mission. Oh, the nightmare. I'm&hellip; free.|Tup and Fives, as the former dies|<ref name="Conspiracy" />}}
Sent back to Kamino for examination, he was captured en route by the Separatists. He was rescued by Fives, Rex and Anakin, and was sent to Kamino. Fives, determined to rescue his friend, performed a scan of his brain and, with the help of a medical droid, AZ-3, removed the "tumor" in his brain&mdash;a malfunctioning [[Inhibitor chip/Legends|inhibitor chip]] and placed a [[Medical bandage patch/Legends|medical bandage patch]] over the wound. After the surgery, he seemed happy, saying he was free from "the mission that never ends...the mission in our nightmares...", before passing away.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I stunned him, sir.''"<br />"''Nice work, Tup.|Rex, commending Tup's suppression of Krell|<ref name="COK" />}}
[[File:Tup-CTRaF.png|thumb|left|250px|Tup in full armor]]
Tup, as he was a relatively new clone trooper, followed along behind Jesse, Rex, Dogma, Fives and Hardcase.<ref name="DOU" /> He adopted some of their personalities while keeping his cautious nature his own, though when he was in battle he became tense and nervous. Throughout the battle on Umbara, he was torn between the undying loyalty that Dogma showed Krell and the leadership of Captain Rex.

Despite the fact that he was a rookie, Tup managed to lure Krell into a trap and subdue him with a stun blast, leading to the incarceration and eventual execution of the traitorous Jedi.

Like all clones of Jango Fett, Tup stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall. Tup grew out his hair and put it up in a bun. He sported a tear drop [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] under his right eye and his helmet had a tear drop design that reflected his tattoo.<ref name="DOU" />

By 20 BBY, however, he ended up having [[Schizophrenia|schizophrenic]] episodes where he entered a trance about "good soldiers always following orders," which eventually led to him shooting a Jedi commander in the head during combat. This was the result of a defective biochip that had been implanted into his brain during his development, which carried a [[Order 66/Legends|secret order]] against Jedi commanders when the time came.

==Equipment==
During the Battle of Umbara, Tup was equipped with the [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II battle armor]],<ref name="DOU" /> a lightweight and adaptable version of the clone troopers' [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|original armor]] that became the standard uniform for clones in the Grand Army of the Republic.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Tup used a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] and a [[Mortar/Legends|mortar launcher]] during the battle of Umbara. As a soldier of the 501st Legion, Tup's armor sported the [[blue]] markings of the 501st.<ref name="DOU" /> Tup personalized his armor by painting a blue tear (identical to, and in the same positioning as, his tattoo) under his right eye on his helmet and one on each shoulder plate.

==Behind the scenes==
Tup first appeared in the episode "[[Darkness on Umbara]]" of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''. He was voiced by actor [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who voiced all of the clone troopers in the TV series.<ref name="DOU" /> Tup was featured in a promotional video on [[StarWars.com]], in which it was announced that ''The Clone Wars'' was ending, and he was shown to appear in an as-of-yet unreleased story arc that is expected to be released as bonus content.<ref name="New Direction">{{SW|url=news/a-new-direction-for-lucasfilm-animation|text=A New Direction for Lucasfilm Animation}}</ref>
